subject: Orbital Health CRM: forecast cleanup and commit confirmation
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Orbital Health CRM: forecast cleanup and commit confirmation

Team — quick ask to get our Q3 numbers tight: Orbital Health (RW-2026-089) shows $620k in the CRM spread across three opportunity lines but the records are inconsistent on SKU and probability. Finance needs a cleaned record for Friday's forecast commit. Can you help with the following by EOD Thursday?

- Normalize the product/SKU to one line item: REDWOOD-DEDICATED-4GPU (this was the customer's requested configuration during demo).
- Confirm the net ARR: current line items sum to $620,000 but contract-level discounts imply $558,000 net. Please confirm final amount and list any open discounts.
- Set a single canonical "next step" and a firm close date (we currently have two conflicting close dates: 2026-08-12 and 2026-09-01).
- Update probability to reflect your best-case commit (suggested: 70% if legal procurement is engaged; 40% if only initial technical review).

I attached the latest MAPlan and a CSV template for the CRM update. If helpful I'll jump on a 15-min sync with Procurement and Legal to finalize numbers.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Orbital_Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.pdf (application/pdf), CRM-update-template.csv (text/csv)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Orbital Health CRM: forecast cleanup and commit confirmation

Karthik — thanks for the breakdown. Quick updates from my side after yesterday's call with Lena:

- Product/SKU: Customer confirmed they want Dedicated 4xA100 equivalent and we should record REDWOOD-DEDICATED-4GPU. I'll collapse the three lines into one in HubSpot.
- Amount: The list price across lines was $620,000. Procurement asked for a 10% strategic partner discount; commercial is indicating we can offer 8% now with a 2% uplift if they sign by 2026-08-15. Expect final net to be $570,400 if they accept the 8% (we're pushing for $558k but that's contingent on a prepay clause).
- Close date & next step: They're running procurement + security review in parallel. I'll set close date to 2026-08-15 (target) and next step to "Procurement final pricing approval" with a mandatory Legal checklist completed.
- Probability: moving to 65% given active procurement and CS engagement. If Legal redlines come back this week, we can push to 80% after sign-off.

I'll update HubSpot now and add a short note in the deal timeline with the pricing scenarios. Looping in Lena so procurement sees the timeline.

—Marissa
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Marissa / Karthik — confirming receipt and timeframe. A few clarifications from procurement:

- We can commit to final pricing approval by 2026-08-10 provided Legal accepts the limited data residency clause.
- We prefer an itemized quote showing pre-discount and post-discount ARR to share with our finance committee.
- If we get the slightly improved 10% discount and a 12-month prepay option, we can move to an approved status the week of 2026-08-03.

I'll attach our preferred contract language in a separate email to Legal. For CRM, please show the three scenarios (list price, 8% discount net, 10% discount partner net) and note that procurement is aiming for 10% + prepay. We will confirm by 2026-08-03 at the latest.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Procurement, Orbital Health

Thanks all — quick finance confirmation for the commit meeting:

- Use net amount = $570,400 (8% discount) as the conservative commit for Friday's forecast. Reason: procurement has not formally confirmed 10% and prepay yet.
- Probability: record as 65% in the commit column. We'll mark an upside scenario of $558,000 @ 80% once prepay + 10% is confirmed and signed.
- Please ensure the deal record has: canonical SKU = REDWOOD-DEDICATED-4GPU, close date = 2026-08-15 (target), next step = Procurement final pricing approval, and attach Orbital_Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.pdf.

I updated the HubSpot deal record and added a note referencing deal RW-2026-089. If anything changes before the 08/06 commit freeze, ping finance and I'll recalc.

—Sean

Redwood Inference
